# Condition Desk for Weather-Sensitive Field Operations

Capability ID: condition-desk-field-ops-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/condition-desk-field-ops-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Use this when

- can my crews work tomorrow
- weather go no-go for field crews
- jobsite weather risk
- roofing weather decision
- construction weather operations
- air quality work decision

## Problem

Field teams need operational go/no-go decision support against their own tolerances rather than scattered weather/hazard tabs.

## Inputs

Locations, work type, customer-defined thresholds/tolerances and operating window.

## Outputs

Conditions and hazards evaluated against defined thresholds with source health and evidence snapshot.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $199-$399/month small team, $499+/month multi-site; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; notification/commercial reliability verification pending.

Decision support only; customer retains operational authority. Payment/subscription requires explicit confirmation.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
